boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Alabama at Birmingham
boards.description: Ten currently documented food stops on or near the UAB medical district, with late availability noted from direct sources.

cards.title: WOW Wings Late Nite
cards.subtitle: McMahon Food Hall, UAB
cards.notes: Order through the Everyday app, then use the McMahon Food Hall pickup location during its documented evening service window.
cards.short_summary: A campus pickup option with service through midnight Wednesday–Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB Student Affairs states that WOW Wings Late Nite operates Wednesday–Sunday from 4:00 PM to 12:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Late Night Dining/New Location-McMahon Food Hall
cards.access_notes: Documented hours: Wednesday–Sunday, 4:00 PM–12:00 AM. Order through the Everyday app; pickup is at McMahon Food Hall.

cards.title: Vocelli Pizza at Camp Hall
cards.subtitle: 1516 10th Ave S, Camp Hall first floor
cards.notes: Use the Camp Hall location for a late pizza pickup or delivery option; confirm availability in the ordering channel before heading over.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus pizza counter with delivery listed until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB Dining lists Vocelli Pizza at Camp Hall with delivery until 12:00 AM daily; its dining room closes earlier.
cards.access_notes: UAB lists delivery until 12:00 AM daily. Dining room closes at 10:00 PM Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 PM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Starbucks Coffee, North Pavilion
cards.subtitle: UAB Hospital North Pavilion, second floor
cards.notes: For a weekday late stop inside the medical district, use the North Pavilion second-floor full-service Starbucks before the listed midnight close.
cards.short_summary: A hospital-campus coffee shop with midnight weekday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB Hospital’s 2026 patient guide lists Starbucks on the North Pavilion second floor open Monday–Friday from 5:00 AM to 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Documented hours: Monday–Friday, 5:00 AM–12:00 AM; Saturday–Sunday, 8:00 AM–6:00 PM. Located on North Pavilion’s second floor.

cards.title: Panera Bread, North Pavilion
cards.subtitle: UAB Hospital North Pavilion, second floor
cards.notes: Use the North Pavilion second-floor Panera for an evening meal on a weekday; weekend service ends earlier, so check the day first.
cards.short_summary: A UAB Hospital food option documented until 10 PM on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB Hospital’s 2026 patient guide lists Panera Bread on the North Pavilion second floor open Monday–Friday from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Documented hours: Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–10:00 PM; Saturday–Sunday, 10:00 AM–6:30 PM. North Pavilion second floor.

cards.title: Bistro on the Pavilion
cards.subtitle: UAB Hospital North Pavilion Food Court
cards.notes: Head to the North Pavilion Food Court for the named bistro when you need a documented on-site option after typical dinner hours.
cards.short_summary: A hospital food-court counter listed through 1 AM every day.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB Hospital’s 2026 patient guide lists Bistro on the Pavilion open 11:00 AM to 1:00 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Documented hours: 11:00 AM–1:00 AM every day. Located in the North Pavilion Food Court on the second floor.

cards.title: McDonald's on 5th Avenue South
cards.subtitle: 1501 5th Ave S, Birmingham
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need the latest documented access; the restaurant lobby has earlier midnight closing hours.
cards.short_summary: A nearby drive-thru listed as open 24 hours daily.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists the 1501 5th Avenue South drive-thru as open 24 hours daily; restaurant and lobby hours run to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: open 24 hours daily. Restaurant and lobby: 5:00 AM–12:00 AM daily.

cards.title: Taco Bell on 7th Avenue South
cards.subtitle: 2124 7th Ave S, Birmingham
cards.notes: Plan this as a drive-thru or takeout stop after the dining room closes; the published drive-thru schedule runs into early morning.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Taco Bell with drive-thru service documented as late as 4 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 2124 7th Avenue South drive-thru open until 4:00 AM Wednesday–Saturday and until 3:00 AM Sunday–Tuesday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until 4:00 AM Wednesday–Saturday; until 3:00 AM Sunday–Tuesday. The listed dine-in hours end at 10:00 PM.

cards.title: Ruscelli's
cards.subtitle: 2801 7th Ave S, Birmingham
cards.notes: Use the published late-night schedule to time pickup or delivery, and confirm the day because Monday is listed as closed.
cards.short_summary: A Southside pizza restaurant with service as late as 2 AM on selected nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Ruscelli’s lists late-night hours until 2:00 AM Tuesday–Saturday, with Sunday service until 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Late-night hours: Tuesday–Thursday 9:00 PM–2:00 AM; Friday–Saturday 5:00 PM–2:00 AM; Sunday 5:00 PM–12:00 AM; Monday closed.

cards.title: The Purple Onion Lakeview
cards.subtitle: 737 29th St S, Birmingham
cards.notes: Use the online ordering page to verify the current closing time and place a pickup or delivery order before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Lakeview deli and grill whose ordering page lists service until 3:45 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: The Purple Onion Lakeview’s direct online ordering page lists the location at 737 29th Street South as closing at 3:45 AM.
cards.source_title: The Purple Onion Lakeview online ordering
cards.access_notes: The direct ordering page lists 737 29th St S and says it closes at 3:45 AM; verify current ordering availability before departure.

cards.title: Al's Deli & Grill
cards.subtitle: 1629 10th Ave S, Birmingham
cards.notes: Use Al’s when you need an independent food stop near campus; check the day-specific close before leaving, since its schedule varies.
cards.short_summary: A Five Points-area deli and grill documented with late service every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps lists Al’s Deli & Grill at 1629 10th Avenue South open until midnight Sunday–Wednesday, 2:00 AM Thursday and Saturday, and 3:00 AM Friday.
cards.source_title: Al's Deli & Grill on Apple Maps
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: until 12:00 AM Sunday–Wednesday, 2:00 AM Thursday and Saturday, and 3:00 AM Friday. Confirm before visiting.
